;Armed conflicts and attacks
*Packages containing suspected [[improvised explosive device]]s are found near [[Heathrow Airport]], [[London City Airport]], and [[London Waterloo station]] in [[London]], [[England]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-london-47457477 (BBC News)]

;Arts and culture
*Japanese architect [[Arata Isozaki]] is announced as the winner of the 2019 [[Pritzker Prize]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-47462803 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[Management of HIV/AIDS]]
**An [[HIV|HIV-positive]] man, identified as "the London patient", is the second known adult worldwide cleared of the HIV virus after a [[Hematopoietic stem cell transplantation|bone marrow transplant]] from an HIV-resistant donor. He has been in remission from HIV for 18 months and is no longer taking HIV drugs. [https://www.bbc.com/news/health-47421855 (BBC News)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/health/2019/03/05/decade-after-first-person-was-cured-hiv-second-patient-is-long-term-remission/?utm_term=.c5399ea1ddf8 (''The Washington Post'')] [https://www.irishtimes.com/news/health/hiv-patient-in-uk-cleared-of-aids-virus-1.3814967 (''The Irish Times'')] [https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-019-00798-3 (''Nature'')]
*The US [[Food and Drug Administration]] approves [[Janssen Pharmaceutica]]'s [[esketamine]] for treatment-resistant depression. The drug is the chemical cousin of [[ketamine]], a powerful anesthetic and recreational drug, and the first major new depression treatment to be approved by the FDA in more than 30 years. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/05/health/esketamine-depression-nasal-spray-fda-bn/index.html (CNN)] [https://techcrunch.com/2019/03/05/fda-approves-esketamine-nasal-spray-the-first-new-major-depression-drug-in-more-than-30-years/ (TechCrunch)]

;Politics and elections
*United States' [[Food and Drug Administration]] commissioner [[Scott Gottlieb]] announces his resignation "in the next month". [https://www.cnn.com/2019/03/05/politics/gottlieb-resigning-fda-health-bn/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2019 Guatemalan general election]]
**[[Semilla (Guatemala)|Semilla]] announces [[Jonathan Menkos|Jonathan Menkos Zeissig]] as [[running mate]] of [[Thelma Aldana]]. Aldana will be proclaimed presidential candidate on March 10. [https://lahora.gt/thelma-aldana-y-jonathan-menkos-son-el-binomio-de-semilla/ (''La Hora'')]

**[[Underdog]] [[AFC Ajax]] defeats defending champions [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] 4–1, and advances to [[2018–19 UEFA Champions League#Quarter-finals|quarter-finals]] on aggregate 5–3, marking the end of Real Madrid's European dominance.
